ai.seo_question: Who are the two faithful servants mentioned in Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the two sons of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph), Asir and Zimra, who remained steadfast in faith while imprisoned, or more broadly to the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate exemplars of divine servitude. It underscores the principle that true nobility lies not in lineage or power, but in piety and unwavering belief, a key theme in understanding the status of the Imams as the perfect 'Abd Allah (Servants of God).
